footwear-1-usage-scene-1.reviewedScenario: Omar wants shoes he can put on without tying laces. He chooses slip-ons. The sneakers and canvas shoes he tried have laces.
footwear-1-usage-scene-1.imageAlt: Two gray canvas shoes without laces rest on a woven mat on a wooden floor.

footwear-1-usage-scene-2.reviewedScenario: Omar examines espadrilles with canvas uppers and woven rope around the soles. The moccasins and boat shoes beside them have different soles.
footwear-1-usage-scene-2.reviewedQuestion: Which shoes have woven rope around the soles?
footwear-1-usage-scene-2.imageAlt: Two pale canvas shoes with braided rope-covered soles rest on a wooden surface.

footwear-1-usage-scene-3.reviewedScenario: Omar compares high-tops that rise above the ankles with low-tops that finish below them. The platform shoes have much thicker soles. The skate shoes have flat soles designed for skateboarding, but Omar is comparing ankle heights.
footwear-1-usage-scene-3.reviewedQuestion: Which shoes rise above the ankles?
footwear-1-usage-scene-3.imageAlt: Two black canvas ankle-high sneakers with white laces and rubber toe caps rest on a wooden floor.

footwear-1-usage-scene-4.reviewedScenario: The assistant shows Derby shoes with open lacing. The lace panels sit on top of the upper. The Oxford shoes have closed lacing.
footwear-1-usage-scene-4.reviewedQuestion: Which shoes have open lacing in the description?
footwear-1-usage-scene-4.imageAlt: A close view of two brown lace-up shoes shows separate lace panels above the uppers; the toes extend outside the frame.

footwear-1-usage-scene-5.reviewedScenario: Omar tries loafers that slip onto his feet. He leaves the brogues and the monk-strap shoes with buckles on the shelf.
footwear-1-usage-scene-5.imageAlt: Two brown slip-on shoes with stitched toes and low heels rest on a wooden floor.

footwear-2-usage-scene-1.reviewedScenario: Mina puts low-cut closed pumps on the formal shelf. The stilettos have much thinner high heels, and the kitten heels have short slender heels.
footwear-2-usage-scene-1.reviewedQuestion: Which low-cut closed shoes does Mina put on the shelf?
footwear-2-usage-scene-1.imageAlt: A black closed-toe shoe with a low-cut opening and a block heel rests on a wooden surface.

footwear-2-usage-scene-2.reviewedScenario: A customer needs shoes for a formal meeting. Mina shows the dress shoes. The block heels and ankle boots are on another shelf.
footwear-2-usage-scene-2.reviewedQuestion: Which general category does Mina show for the formal meeting?
footwear-2-usage-scene-2.imageAlt: Two polished brown lace-up shoes with low heels rest on a wooden floor.

footwear-2-usage-scene-3.reviewedScenario: Mina checks Chelsea boots with elastic panels at the sides. The knee-high boots are taller, and the combat boots have laces.
footwear-2-usage-scene-3.reviewedQuestion: Which boots have elastic side panels?
footwear-2-usage-scene-3.imageAlt: Two brown ankle boots with black elastic side panels and pull tabs stand on a wooden bench.

footwear-2-usage-scene-4.reviewedScenario: Mina places cowboy boots on a separate shelf. They have tall shafts and angled heels. The rain boots and snow boots are elsewhere.
footwear-2-usage-scene-4.reviewedQuestion: Which boots does Mina place on a separate shelf?
footwear-2-usage-scene-4.imageAlt: Two tall brown boots with stitched shafts and angled heels stand on wooden boards.

footwear-2-usage-scene-5.reviewedScenario: The customer asks to see the work boots near the counter. Mina brings them over and leaves the hiking and riding boots on their shelves. The hiking boots are for walks on rough ground; the customer asks for work boots today.
footwear-2-usage-scene-5.reviewedQuestion: Which boots does the customer ask to see?
footwear-2-usage-scene-5.imageAlt: Two worn brown lace-up boots with padded collars and thick treaded soles stand on wooden boards beside gravel.

footwear-3-usage-scene-1.reviewedScenario: Nabil checks flip-flops with a Y-shaped strap between the toes. The sandals and slides beside them have other strap designs.
footwear-3-usage-scene-1.reviewedQuestion: Which footwear has a Y-shaped strap between the toes?
footwear-3-usage-scene-1.imageAlt: Two blue flip-flops with Y-shaped straps rest on pale paving stones.

footwear-3-usage-scene-2.reviewedScenario: Nabil checks platform sandals with thick raised soles. The gladiator sandals have many straps, and the wedges rise mainly under the heels.
footwear-3-usage-scene-2.reviewedQuestion: Which sandals have thick raised soles?
footwear-3-usage-scene-2.imageAlt: Two brown sandals with ankle straps and thick rope-covered soles rest on stone paving.

footwear-3-usage-scene-3.reviewedScenario: Nabil packs strappy sandals with several narrow straps. The woven huaraches and closed clogs go in other boxes.
footwear-3-usage-scene-3.reviewedQuestion: Which sandals have several narrow straps?
footwear-3-usage-scene-3.imageAlt: Two brown sandals with crossing straps and buckled ankle straps rest on a wooden bench.

footwear-3-usage-scene-4.reviewedScenario: The order list requests running shoes for a running club. Nabil packs those and leaves the mules and cross-trainers on the shelf.
footwear-3-usage-scene-4.reviewedQuestion: Which shoes does the running club order?
footwear-3-usage-scene-4.imageAlt: Two gray lace-up mesh sneakers with thick white soles rest on a paved path.

footwear-3-usage-scene-5.reviewedScenario: The tennis club orders tennis shoes. Nabil packs the requested pair, not the basketball shoes or soccer cleats.
footwear-3-usage-scene-5.reviewedQuestion: Which shoes does the tennis club order?
footwear-3-usage-scene-5.imageAlt: Two white lace-up shoes rest on a blue court surface, with one shoe turned to show its zigzag sole tread.

footwear-4-usage-scene-1.reviewedScenario: Sam brings dance shoes to his adult dance class. He leaves his climbing shoes and cycling shoes in the sports cupboard.
footwear-4-usage-scene-1.reviewedQuestion: Which shoes does Sam bring to the class?
footwear-4-usage-scene-1.imageAlt: A matching pair of black lace-up low-heeled shoes rests on an empty wooden studio floor.

footwear-4-usage-scene-2.reviewedScenario: At the bowling alley, Sam collects bowling shoes from the desk. His soft slippers are at home.
footwear-4-usage-scene-2.reviewedQuestion: Which shoes does Sam collect from the desk?
footwear-4-usage-scene-2.imageAlt: A matching pair of cream-and-dark-brown lace-up shoes sits alone on a shelf in front of blurred empty bowling lanes.
